scan_order_surface_label: Example source/visual/focus-order posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded sequence-coherence surface for official voter-information routes where layout or promotion choices can change the apparent order of answer-bearing content.

reviewed_route_variants.layout_variant_label: Desktop cards with promoted current option
reviewed_route_variants.sequence_sensitive_blocks_note: The current recommended option card is visually featured and must remain coherent with source and focus order.
reviewed_route_variants.source_vs_visual_order_note: The visually promoted card is also placed early enough in source order that keyboard and speech users encounter it in the same meaningful sequence.
reviewed_route_variants.focus_travel_note: Tab order follows the same left-to-right or top-to-bottom answer sequence implied by the visible layout.
reviewed_route_variants.narrow_layout_note: When the grid stacks to one column, the promoted option remains explicit and sequence meaning does not invert silently.

source_vs_visual_order_note: Route owners reviewed whether any flex/grid placement, reversal, or featured-slot treatment changes the apparent answer order without matching source order.
focus_order_note: Interactive elements follow the same meaningful sequence users perceive from the visible route structure.
featured_or_promoted_block_note: Any featured or recommended answer block is explicitly identified and remains coherent with source/focus sequence rather than depending only on visual placement.
layout_reordering_controls_note: The route records whether reverse-direction utilities, explicit order values, or breakpoint-specific promotion rules are used on answer-bearing content.
narrow_layout_sequence_note: Desktop and narrow layouts were checked for sequence drift when columns wrap, sidebars move, or promoted blocks restack.
help_or_overview_escape_note: If the apparent answer priority changes or no single lane clearly controls, the route preserves a visible path to broader official help or overview content.
